title: Endocrinologist visit
what: A doctor who treats hormone conditions: thyroid problems, diabetes, and weight and metabolism problems.
why: For diabetes, thyroid changes, sudden weight change, constant tiredness, or irregular periods.
tell_doctor: What bothers you, and since when
All your medicines, especially hormones and diabetes medicines
Thyroid conditions or diabetes in relatives
If you are pregnant or planning to be

prepare.title: Tests
prepare.text: If the doctor may send you for blood tests right away, ask the clinic whether to come fasting.

prepare.title: Diary
prepare.text: With diabetes, bring your blood sugar records and your meter.

prepare.title: Past tests
prepare.text: Bring past hormone tests and thyroid ultrasounds, if you had them.

bring: Your glucose meter and sugar diary, if you have them
Past test results, discharge papers, and reports
A list of your medicines, or the packs themselves
steps: The doctor asks about your symptoms and medicines
Your blood pressure, height, and weight are measured
Your neck and thyroid are felt
feel: Nothing unpleasant. It is a regular checkup
Feeling the neck does not hurt
after: Have the tests ordered and come back with the results
Do not change medicine doses on your own. Only your doctor decides
red_flags: Very high or very low blood sugar, confusion, or severe weakness: call emergency services

faq.a: Not for the visit itself. But if the doctor may send you for a blood test right away, fasting helps. Check with the clinic.

faq.q: Should I have hormone tests first?
faq.a: You can bring past tests. The doctor will decide which ones are needed now.

reminders.text: Endocrinologist visit tomorrow. Bring your test results, sugar diary, and medicine list.
